Hospitals were understaffed, and many people died at home, so those deaths were not counted as 新冠肺炎 deaths. Also, because 墨西哥 has a large informal economy in which more than 50% of workers do not receive government benefits, COVID cases and deaths in this sector were under-reported. In addition, understaffed hospitals could not keep up with the huge number of 新冠患者 and the required documentation.
